description: WhatsApp delivery via Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API: free text (the booking chat bot's replies), approved Utility templates (the hospital-initiated confirmation and day-before reminder, gated by TURNOS_WA_NOTIFY / TURNOS_WA_TEST_RECIPIENTS) and, with OTP_PROVIDER=meta, the verification code as the approved Authentication template named by the optional META_WA_OTP_TEMPLATE (no variable = no code over Meta; not a required config key). A Meta rate limit pauses every Meta send (Retry-After, 60 s default, 15 min cap). Implementation stays in otp_send.py (NOT moved into this directory — see adapter.py for why); this manifest documents its config keys for manage.py/Settings.
